items.caption: This oracle-style 星 form has a tall central stroke with short branches and several surrounding enclosed marks. It is presented as a modern redraw of a catalogued Shang-style form; interpretations of how the star-like element and 生 relate in the earliest forms differ.
items.alt: Black oracle-style glyph with a tall branched central shape and four separate enclosed marks around it.
items.selection_reason: The visible form is legible and relevant to 星’s early graphic history. It helps show the form discussed in accounts that connect 星 with a star depiction and 生, while leaving the disputed early sequence open.

limitations.text: This is a modern digital redraw, not an image of an excavated object. Early accounts disagree on whether oracle forms already combined star imagery with 生 or whether a 晶-based form preceded 星 with 生; the sequence remains unsettled.
